slides.texte_overlay:
the 5 minute rules that
make life feel lighter

the two minute tidy

if tidying something takes less than two minutes, do it now. a clear home gives you a clearer head, and you stop feeling like life is slipping away from you.

the five minute walk

when you feel stuck or anxious, walk for five minutes before deciding anything. moving your body changes your mood faster than overthinking ever will.

the five minute lesson

learn something just for the joy of it every day, like a strange animal or a forgotten empire. five minutes of pure curiosity makes ordinary days feel lighter.
slides.texte_sophia:
the five minute lesson

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something just for fun, like a forgotten empire. i do it with the Sophia app, and it makes my days feel so much lighter.

slides.texte_overlay:
the one line diary

before bed, write a single sentence about your day. a tiny habit you never skip is far better than a big, ambitious journal you give up on after only a week.

the reply rule

if a message takes less than five minutes to answer, reply right away. unanswered messages weigh on your mind far more than the few minutes they would take.
